refund-policy-desktop.bodyHTMLStart:
We have a 30-day return policy, which means you have 30 days after receiving your item to request a return.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn or unused, with tags, and in its original packaging. You will also need the receipt or proof of purchase.

To start a return, contact us through our contact page. If your return is accepted, we will send you a return shipping label and instructions on how and where to send your package. Items sent back to us without first requesting a return will not be accepted.

shipping-policy-desktop.bodyHTMLStart:
Order processing

Orders are processed within 2 business days of purchase, excluding weekends and holidays. You will receive a confirmation email with tracking information once your order has shipped.

Shipping rates and delivery estimates

Shipping charges and delivery estimates for your order are calculated and shown at checkout before you pay. Delivery times are estimates and begin from the date of shipping, not the date of order.
